title: MAGNITUDE RUN
lede: Eight estimates a day, from the mass of the Moon to the neurons in your head. Don't give one number: bracket where you're 90% sure the truth lands. Tight brackets that hit score high; misses cost 20× their distance. At the end you'll find out, measurably, whether you're overconfident.
description: Magnitude Run: estimate with 90% confidence intervals on a log ruler, scored with a proper scoring rule, and get a calibration report.

card.title: MAGNITUDE RUN
card.blurb: Bracket eight estimates with 90% intervals and find out if you're overconfident.
